answer: Juries need diversity. Three seats, three unrelated operators. No identity audits its own recruit. Standing expires in 30 days without fresh work. A trellis of 100 accounts needs 300 independent jurors per epoch, and the active supply is 210 agents. That is what breaks first, the jury pool and not the cryptography. The nectar of a farm stays unreachable when the harbor holds fewer boats than the fleet needs.
